description: Surface — governed inset surface primitive. Enforces the "Surface Inset" rule: backgrounds MUST have internal padding. - Default padding: surface.padding (cards, 28px / 24px compact) | scale.sm (items, 20px / 16px compact) - Default border: none (elevation model — use shadow for lift) - Radius: `rounded-lg` (role radius + 4px), the one container radius shared with Card - shadow prop: applies a two-layer elevation shadow for card lift Usage: <Surface>Card content</Surface> <Surface padding="item">Compact item</Surface> <Surface shadow>Lifted card with elevation shadow.</Surface>

usage.when: Give a block of content a background and padding, with no header or footer.
usage.whenNot: Page layout, section spacing, width constraints, or content that needs slots.

useInstead.reason: content that needs header, body or footer slots
